name: 37683-sharegpt-gptoss20b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one vLLM engine on one GPU, `--tensor-parallel-size 1`.
architecture: 21B-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts decoder with MXFP4 expert weights: 24 MoE layers, 32 experts with 4 active per token, hidden size 2880.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, no cooldown, bounded at 500 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. One stream is the declared operating point, not a sweep point; 16 streams is a different setup. Warmup comes OUT of the bound rather than being extra, so roughly the first 50 requests warm the engine and the rest are scored -- read the scored count from `metrics.request_latency.successful.count` rather than computing it. Seed static 37683.
workload: the ShareGPT V3 draw materialised row for row into `configs/data/sharegpt-960-gptoss20b-out300.jsonl` (960 rows) by `configs/data/make-dataset.py`, tokenised with this model's own tokenizer. Mixed, short-tailed prompts: mean 226 tokens (p10 9, p50 103, p90 648, p99 816, max 1013). Every row carries `output_tokens_count: 300`, so the backend sets `ignore_eos` and each request generates exactly 300 tokens. Raw completions (`request_format: plain`), temperature 0. The bound consumes the first 500 rows.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant on a 20-billion-parameter model, one request at a time, 300-token replies, one GPU.
launch:
# The engine is a source checkout of fb4e8bf442c53a211d297d31f0381f16c40b1240
# (`git describe --tags`: v0.17.2rc0-181-gfb4e8bf442c5), named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
# An unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction: do not add keys from another vLLM.

model: openai/gpt-oss-20b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false

# The workload's worst case is 1013 prompt + 300 output tokens. The checkpoint's own default
# context is 131072, which an 80 GB card should not size a KV cache for.
max-model-len: 4096

# vLLM's own default, written out so a change of default cannot move the KV cache size.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
